completion:
If we're performing an ADA access audit, the inspection records will include records from the NYC Design Guidelines Inspector
3. If the NYC Design Guidelines Advisor flagged an issue, do we include the inspection record as further reference?
4. If no inspection records exist, we use in-house SWA inspection records
5. Each inspection record includes: Category, Description of Issue, Exact Footprints and Building ID, Video www.x.com/t >>>..., Date.
6. Description of issue has options based on checklist categories that relate to ADA requirements (from my text description of what visually appears in the video)
7. We do not have a NYC Design Guidelines dataset/feature we can sort/filter on
8. If the NYC Design Guidelines Advisor flags an issue, capture a video/thumbnail of the presence of the issue

## Description of Accessible issue categories:
1. No sidewalk
2. Insufficient sidewalk width
3. No sidewalk/ramp
